description: Parameters whose accepted values are effectively unbounded: raw SQL, an arbitrary URL, a filesystem path, or a shell command. Detected three ways — by name, by description language, and structurally by an unconstrained string type.
sourceNotes: The structural signal is the interesting one: a string parameter with no enum, no pattern, no maxLength and no format accepts anything at all, regardless of what it is called. Reported separately from the name-based signals so a reader can weigh them differently.

structural.unconstrainedString: type is 'string' with no enum, pattern, maxLength, or format
structural.note: Reported as a distinct signal so it can be excluded by anyone who considers it too broad.
